title: Use of a per-part static key in the ASP Bootloader could allow an attacker to downgrade the Secure Encrypted…
description: CVE-2026-0003 describes a vulnerability in the ASP Bootloader where a per-part static key is used. This flaw could allow an attacker to downgrade the Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware and exploit known vulnerabilities to decrypt memory, potentially leading to loss of confidentiality. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9. No affected versions or patches are specified in the available data.
